title: repoRoot container-root guard hoisted from routes meta into workspace registry lib
summary: U7 moved the container-root guard (never adopt an incidental .graph/.git sitting AT os.tmpdir / os.homedir / filesystem root) from the local POST /workspace climb logic in routes/meta.js INTO lib/workspace-registry.js repoRoot itself, so all callers — daemon, hooks (U4), CLI (U5) — get the guard, not just the one HTTP route. repoRoot now skips marker detection at any dir that isContainerRoot and keeps walking up. The local containers Set check in routes/meta.js was KEPT as cheap defense-in-depth (the climb decision reads clearer with it inline); both layers agree so behavior is unchanged. New tests in test/workspace-registry.test.js stub os.tmpdir/os.homedir via a module reload to prove the guard, plus a positive control that a real repo nested BELOW a container is still adopted (38 to 41 passing).
